newsitem.title: FRANCE: French ex-Hearts striker jailed on drugs charges.
newsitem.headline: French ex-Hearts striker jailed on drugs charges.

text.p: French former soccer international Stephane Paille, who used to be a striker for the Scottish club Hearts, was jailed for four months on drugs charges on Wednesday.
The court in the French town of Bourg-en-Bresse also gave Paille, 32, a 14-month suspended sentence for buying and using cocaine and being an accomplice in drug-trafficking.
Paille has denied the charges. His lawyer said he would appeal.
